ts-cp.note: The foreign-entry case mirrors: on the TS server the foreign project is py-project (python runtime, unresolvable and inoperable here). Only can_refresh_project stays true (refresh is not operability-gated, #563); start/review/cancel/resolve are false. enforcement_events is false too — the feed is resolution-bound (#723 slice 2), so an unresolvable project reports it unavailable on both editions, exactly like the base golden's unresolvable ts-project. github_provenance is false too on both editions: it is resolution-bound AND needs a github repo source (#727), and these stub projects are unresolvable with no recorded source, so the capability is false everywhere just like the base golden's unresolvable ts-project.
